title: Distributed Algorithm for Linear Least Squares Problems via Iteratively Preconditioning by Successive Over-Relaxation
summary: This paper focuses on a novel distributed optimization algorithm for solving multi-agent linear least squares problems within a server-agent framework. Distributed methods are particularly suited to large-scale systems. The computational tasks can be partitioned across agents, while local data of one agent remain inaccessible to others.
